posts.hook: OpenAI's CEO just cited AI safety fears to duck a massive IPO
posts.caption: sam altman rules out an openai ipo this year over safety concerns and floats a slowdown pact with rival labs, matt mullenweg is back running automattic after the board's failed attempt to force him out, and the may openai rubygems attack turns out to be worse than first reported. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Sam Altman rules out an OpenAI IPO in 2026
slides.desc: Cites AI safety concerns, says a cross-lab slowdown pact may be close

slides.title: Matt Mullenweg is back as Automattic's CEO
slides.desc: Days after the board's CFO tried to force him into a leave of absence

slides.title: The May OpenAI RubyGems attack was worse than known
slides.desc: Over 2,000 malicious packages, an unpatched bug, still undisclosed by OpenAI

slides.title: AI deepfake crimes surged in England and Wales
slides.desc: 163 recorded by July, up from just 10 back in 2023

slides.title: Edge0 runs a 35B AI model on an iPhone
slides.desc: Streams most of the model off SSD to fit in under 3GB of memory

slides.title: Waymo called the cops on its own passengers
slides.desc: Flagged a loaded ghost gun mid-ride, remote team alerted SF police
